title: Scare

inlines.v: SCARE, verb transitive [Latin ex and cor, heart; but qu.] To fright; to terrify suddenly; to strike with sudden terror. The noise of thy crow-bow will scare the herd, and so my shot is lost. To scare away, to drive away by frightening.
